title: Find Company Phone Numbers in Bulk With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: From a list of company names to their main phone lines
cover: In this video we are going to see how to find company phone numbers in bulk using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. Ten companies went in, and each one came back with its main phone line, ready to export and call. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of companies in, phone numbers out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the website of every company on a list.
outroHeadline: Get the phone numbers for your list
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results of find_company_phone (LinkFinder AI API), 12 Nov 2026

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Select Company name. That searches the company's main line, for one credit per company.
Fill in the company name. We type HubSpot.
A couple of seconds later you have HubSpot's main number, eight eight eight, four eight two, seven seven six eight.
Now do it for a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has ten software companies.
You see the rows before anything runs, so you know exactly what you will pay for.
The numbers come in row by row: Tesla, Shopify, Zoom, Airbnb.
Ten companies, ten phone numbers, every one marked Found.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your dialer or your CRM.
